_comment: Waivers for blocking findings in Docs/qa/graybox_spec_report.json, read by
Content/Python/polish_readiness.py. Each waiver must name the finding's full
(criterion, volume, detail) identity: the greybox report files several
independent blockers under one criterion for one volume, and a two-field key
would let a waiver meant for one silently cover a sibling.
A waiver records a decision. It does not resolve the disagreement, and a
waiver naming a finding that no longer exists is reported STALE rather than
ignored. To un-waive, delete the entry and re-run polish_readiness.py.

waivers.detail: y bbox 10.700 vs spec 14.000 (off by 3.300, tolerance 1.400)
waivers.rationale: ACCEPTED AS MEASURED, NOT RESOLVED. Authored 10.7 m against a 14.0 m spec with 1.4 m tolerance. AGENTS.md forbids rescaling authored geometry, so the spec and the geometry still disagree. Raised 2026-10-03 and not directed otherwise, so it is carried as a recorded waiver rather than an open question.
waivers.note: Downstream work must not read this as a settled size. If the island is later resized, or the spec reconciled to 10.7 m, delete this entry and re-run the gate.
